{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].shape[0]}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {df.shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {df.shape[0] - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check assay_batch values
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution
print(f"Max sample_seq: {df['sample_seq'].max()}")

# Summary of biomarker_final
print(f"Original biomarker_final mean: {df['biomarker_final'].mean():.2f}")

# Check if any biomarker_final is suspiciously high (e.g., batch-B not corrected)
print(f"Max biomarker_final: {df['biomarker_final'].max():.2f}")

# Note: We'll correct batch-B values after deduplication

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# But only if we're not using baseline for filtering — this question is about final biomarker
# So we keep all rows for deduplication, but only one per patient

# Create a copy for deduplication
df_dedup = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Now correct batch-B values: divide by 10 to convert from µg/L to ng/mL
# Only apply to assay_batch == 'B'
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Now compute the mean
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean()

print(f"Deduplicated data shape: {df_dedup.shape}")
print(f"Corrected mean biomarker_final: {mean_biomarker_final:.2f} ng/mL")

# Final check: ensure no -999 in biomarker_final? Not required per question, but safe
print(f"Number of rows with biomarker_final == -999: {df_dedup[df_dedup['biomarker_final'] == -999].shape[0]}")"}
